annotation.evidence_span: MUST be sent at the same encryption level
annotation.interpretation_a: Retransmissions of data carried in CRYPTO frames from a lower encryption level must use the same encryption level as the original packet, even if higher levels are available.
annotation.interpretation_b: Retransmissions of data carried in CRYPTO frames from a lower encryption level must use the same encryption level as the original packet, and no higher encryption levels may be used for any retransmissions of that data.
annotation.justification: The clause states retransmissions "MUST" be sent at the same encryption level, but doesn't specify what happens if that level is no longer available or permissible. This creates an incomplete constraint.
annotation.missing_information: The clause does not define what happens if a higher encryption level is not available. Is it an error condition? Is the retransmission simply not sent?
